[[Galactic Solutions Industries]] maintained an '''Animal Weapons Division''' that researched and produced weaponized creatures. One of their projects was the retrieval of [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] in hopes of [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] the creatures.
